messages:
alex: hey folks — opened a small docs PR to tidy the Node SDK quickstart and fix a typo in the auth section. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :eyes:
priya: on it, will skim now. if it's small I can approve today.
liam: quick note — the snippet change touches the example that lives in examples/node; please make sure the example still runs. i can run it after you merge.
jules: alex can you paste the failing snippet here? iirc last time about 2 lines needed adjusted for the new client API.
alex: sure — the main change is switching from `new Redwood()` to `createClient({ apiKey })`. diff:```diff
- const client = new Redwood(process.env.RW_API_KEY)
+ const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
```
priya: lgtm, that's consistent with the SDK rename. i have one tiny nit about wording: "get started in minutes" -> "get started in under 5 minutes". i'll push a micro edit if that's okay.
alex: please do, thanks. i want to merge before EOD if we can. planning to sync docs with the latest release tomorrow.
docs-bot: CI check started for pr #482 — spellcheck: passed, link-checker: running.
ci-bot: Link-checker failed: https://example.com/old-link returns 404. (see checks)
alex: ugh, that old-link is from an earlier page — i'll remove it in a follow-up. not blocking this PR if the failing link is outside the changed files.
priya: i can re-run the link-check locally. alex if you want, mark the PR as ready and i'll approve + merge after link-check clears.
liam: i can also run the example in a container and report back within ~30m.
jules: pinging @docs on-call — if anyone else wants to eyeball the wording change.
priya: approved and merged. :shipit: thanks everyone.
alex: amazing, thanks all. will open the follow-up to remove the stale external link.
ci-bot: Merged PR #482 into main — deployment job queued.
docs-bot: deployment succeeded for site v1.12.3.
liam: confirmed the example runs after the change. no runtime regressions. :white_check_mark:
alex: closing the loop — follow-up created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/210
